summary: Add a manually dispatched burst workflow that runs one allowlisted suite (cargo-test, nextest or st-test-all) on an exact commit and reports a burst/SUITE commit status

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: CI only. A new workflow_dispatch workflow; required checks, evidence rules and the merge queue are unchanged.

manual.detail: No action required. Callers may dispatch burst.yml on main; the optional BURST_RUNS_ON repository variable overrides its runner.

recovery.detail: No persistent state. Removing the workflow removes the capability; existing burst/SUITE statuses stay on their commits.
